name: Defensive Asset Switching
rationale: Asset-switching rules test whether moving from risky assets into defensive assets is better than moving to cash.
expected_benefit: Lower opportunity cost than cash exits during risk-off periods.
failure_modes: Defensive assets may fall with equities.
Requires careful cross-asset execution and benchmark alignment.

canonical_variants.name: SPY to TLT regime switch
canonical_variants.description: Hold SPY in risk-on regimes and TLT in risk-off regimes.
canonical_variants.hypothesis_template: Switching from SPY to TLT during equity risk-off regimes may retain more return than cash exits while reducing drawdown.
canonical_variants.minimum_acceptable_performance: Reduce max drawdown by at least 25% relative while retaining at least 80% of benchmark CAGR.

canonical_variants.name: SPY to SHY regime switch
canonical_variants.description: Hold short Treasuries instead of cash during risk-off regimes.
canonical_variants.hypothesis_template: Switching from SPY to short Treasuries during risk-off regimes may improve cash-exit return retention.
canonical_variants.minimum_acceptable_performance: Retain at least 80% of benchmark CAGR and reduce max drawdown by at least 20% relative.

canonical_variants.name: Risk-on/risk-off basket switch
canonical_variants.description: Switch between a risky basket and a defensive basket.
canonical_variants.hypothesis_template: A two-basket risk-on/risk-off switch may improve drawdown-adjusted performance versus a static allocation.
canonical_variants.minimum_acceptable_performance: Improve Sharpe versus the static benchmark after turnover costs.

suggested_validation: Build only after dynamic portfolio rotation exists.
execution_notes: The current portfolio engine does not support signal-driven switching between assets.
